title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: Enhanced Agentic Capabilities at Lower Cost
description: DeepSeek released V4-Flash-0731 with substantially enhanced agentic capabilities, ranking ahead of larger models on Artificial Analysis. At $0.14/million input and $0.27/million output tokens, it offers strong value-per-intelligence with 304B parameters, MIT license, and support for fp8/8-bit precision. Key benchmarks: Terminal Bench 2.1 (82.7%), Toolathlon-Verified (70.3%), DSBench-FullStack (68.7%).
author: DeepSeek AI

title: smevals: Small Evaluation Suites for Model Configurations
description: New tool for running small evaluation suites across different model configurations and grading results, enabling developers to quickly test and compare AI model performance.
author: prime-radiant-inc

title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for LLMs
description: Framework for auditing LLM system prompts with a user-centric approach, enabling better oversight and validation of AI system behavior at the prompt level.
author: Xiangning Lin et al.

title: OSReward: Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models

title: How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents
description: Examines fundamental issues with how current benchmarks score AI agents, revealing potential biases and inaccuracies in evaluating computer-use agent performance.

title: WIDE: Token-level Dynamic Width Pruning for LLMs
description: Optimizes adaptive LLM inference through dynamic pruning techniques, enabling more efficient token-level processing without sacrificing model quality.
